name: Belle
source: A chaotic, highly intellectual aspiring journalist who uses the Debate Club to instigate arguments and test the psychological boundaries of her peers. She thrives on social engineering, utilizing a vast network of school favors to "outsource" camp activities, and frequently derails conversations by introducing complex philosophical thought experiments. Her favorite pastimes include debating time travel paradoxes, proposing simulation theories, and intentionally provoking existential dread in her friends.
